entries.summaryZh: 1885年1月，英国沙漠纵队在苏丹阿布克莱亚与马赫迪军队交战，战斗持续到1月17日前后。这支约1400人的纵队自科尔蒂出发，任务是穿越拜尤达沙漠救援被围困在喀土穆的戈登。英军以方阵击退马赫迪军进攻，但指挥官斯图尔特受致命伤，纵队继续前进，喀土穆仍告陷落。
entries.summaryEn: In January 1885 the British Desert Column fought Mahdist forces at Abu Klea in Sudan. The column of about 1,400 men had set out from Korti to cross the Bayuda Desert and relieve General Gordon at Khartoum; it broke the Mahdist attack in square but its commander Herbert Stewart was mortally wounded, and Khartoum fell before the relief arrived.
entries.significanceZh: 阿布·科里亚之战是戈登救援远征中最激烈的交战，英军虽取胜却未能及时解救喀土穆。
entries.significanceEn: Abu Klea was the hardest fight of the Gordon relief expedition, and the victory came too late to save Khartoum.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1885年1月16日至18日，维基数据P585为1885年1月17日，精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1912年10月22日至24日，第一次巴尔干战争期间，保加利亚第一、第三集团军在柯克基利斯（今土耳其克尔克拉雷利）击败奥斯曼东线集团军并占领该城。奥斯曼军被迫向吕莱布尔加兹一线撤退，北色雷斯大片地区向保加利亚军队敞开，巴尔干同盟由此取得开战以来的决定性进展。
entries.summaryEn: From 22 to 24 October 1912, during the First Balkan War, the Bulgarian First and Third Armies defeated the Ottoman Eastern Army at Kirk Kilisse, today's Kirklareli, and captured the town. The Ottomans fell back towards the Luleburgaz line and much of northern Thrace lay open to Bulgaria, a decisive early success for the Balkan League.
entries.significanceZh: 柯克基利斯之战击溃奥斯曼东线集团军，打开了色雷斯，是巴尔干战争初期战局的决定性转折。
entries.significanceEn: Kirk Kilisse broke the Ottoman Eastern Army and opened Thrace, deciding the opening phase of the First Balkan War.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1912年10月22日至24日，维基数据P585为1912年10月24日，精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.summaryZh: 1915年7月10日至26日，第一次世界大战高加索战役期间，俄军与奥斯曼军队在马拉兹吉尔特一带交战。双方伤亡都很重，俄军向北撤退，土军夺回马拉兹吉尔特并继续向卡拉基利塞推进，随后在8月初的卡拉基利塞战役中被击败。此役是1915年高加索战线拉锯的一部分。
entries.summaryEn: From 10 to 26 July 1915, during the Caucasus campaign of the First World War, Russian and Ottoman forces fought around Malazgirt. Both sides suffered heavy losses; the Russians withdrew north, the Ottomans retook the town and pushed on towards Karakilise, where they were defeated in early August.
entries.significanceZh: 马拉兹吉尔特之战是1915年高加索战线的一次拉锯战，双方都未能取得决定性突破。
entries.significanceEn: Manzikert was one of the attritional seesaw battles of the 1915 Caucasus front, where neither side achieved a decisive breakthrough.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1915年7月10日至26日，维基数据P585为1915年、精度到年，本条只保留年份精度。本条为1915年一战战役，与1071年曼齐刻尔特之战无关。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

This is the First World War battle of 1915, not the better-known Manzikert of 1071. Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1943年12月，第二次世界大战新不列颠战役期间，美军在阿拉威登陆，作为盟军车轮行动中掩护格洛斯特角登陆的牵制行动。日军在兵力劣势下抵抗约一个月，盟军最终控制阿拉威地区。最初设想的鱼雷艇基地后来被认为没有必要而未建，此役确保了后续登陆的侧翼安全。
entries.summaryEn: In December 1943, during the New Britain campaign of the Second World War, US forces landed at Arawe as a diversion for the larger landing at Cape Gloucester under Operation Cartwheel. The outnumbered Japanese resisted for about a month before the Allies secured the area; the planned PT-boat base was never built.
entries.significanceZh: 阿拉威战役是盟军车轮行动中的牵制性登陆，保障了格洛斯特角登陆的侧翼，削弱了日军在新不列颠的防御。
entries.significanceEn: Arawe was the diversionary landing of Operation Cartwheel that shielded the Cape Gloucester operation and weakened the Japanese defence of New Britain.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1943年12月15日登陆、战斗持续约一个月，维基数据P585为1943年12月、精度到月，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle, so only the English article and the Wikidata entity are cited. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 252年，萨珊波斯沙普尔一世以罗马插手亚美尼亚为借口重启战端，在幼发拉底河畔的巴巴利索斯歼灭一支约六万人的罗马军队。罗马东方防线由此洞开，三年后安条克与杜拉欧罗普斯相继陷落。此役仅见于沙普尔一世在纳克什-鲁斯塔姆的铭文，史料极为有限。
entries.summaryEn: In 252 Shapur I of Sasanian Persia resumed war with Rome and destroyed a Roman army of some 60,000 men at Barbalissos on the Euphrates. The Roman east lay open, and Antioch and Dura Europos fell three years later. The battle is known only from Shapur's inscription at Naqsh-e Rostam.
entries.significanceZh: 巴巴利索斯战役摧毁了罗马东方野战军，为萨珊波斯随后攻陷安条克打开了门户。
entries.significanceEn: Barbalissos destroyed the Roman field army in the east and opened the way for the Sasanian capture of Antioch.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记252年，维基数据P585为252年、精度到年，本条只保留年份精度；此役仅见于沙普尔一世铭文，兵力数字出自该铭文。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

The battle is known only from Shapur I's inscription, which is also the source of the troop figure. Chinese Wikipedia has no article, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 646年5月，阿拉伯穆斯林军队在阿姆尔·伊本·阿绥指挥下于埃及尼基乌击败拜占庭军队。此前阿拉伯人已占领亚历山大，拜占庭方面一度收复该城，此役后阿拉伯人重新确立对埃及的控制，拜占庭在埃及的统治彻底结束。尼基乌之战是阿拉伯征服埃及过程中的关键交战之一。
entries.summaryEn: In May 646 Arab Muslim troops under Amr ibn al-Aas defeated a Byzantine army at Nikiou in Egypt. The Byzantines had briefly retaken Alexandria after the first Arab conquest, but the victory at Nikiou re-established Arab control and ended Byzantine rule in Egypt for good.
entries.significanceZh: 尼基乌战役使阿拉伯人重新掌控埃及，结束了拜占庭在埃及的统治，是伊斯兰早期扩张的重要一步。
entries.significanceEn: Nikiou restored Arab control of Egypt and ended Byzantine rule there, a significant step in the early Islamic expansion.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记646年5月，维基数据P585为646年5月、精度到月，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle, so only the English article and the Wikidata entity are cited. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1004年，拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世在征服保加利亚的长期战争中攻克斯科普里。他先取萨尔迪卡（今索非亚），再向北切断沙皇萨穆伊尔与普雷斯拉夫故地的联系，随后南下马其顿，逐步收复色萨利与马其顿东部。斯科普里之战是这场缓慢而系统的征服中的一环。
entries.summaryEn: In 1004 the Byzantine emperor Basil II took Skopje during his long conquest of Bulgaria. Having secured Sardika, modern Sofia, he cut Tsar Samuel's access to the old Bulgarian heartlands and then moved south into Macedonia, steadily recovering Thessaly and eastern Macedonia; Skopje was one stage in that systematic campaign.
entries.significanceZh: 斯科普里之战是巴西尔二世系统性征服保加利亚的关键一步，削弱了萨穆伊尔帝国的核心地带。
entries.significanceEn: Skopje was a key step in Basil II's systematic conquest of Bulgaria and weakened the heartland of Samuel's empire.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1004年，维基数据P585为1004年、精度到年，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.summaryZh: 1274年，蒙古帝国联合高丽发动对日本的第一次入侵，即文永之役。蒙汉高丽联军在博多湾登陆，此前已袭掠对马与壹岐。联军在湾内岛屿建立阵地并攻击本土，却始终无法巩固立足点，数日后撤退。此役展示了蒙古军队的远洋投送能力，也暴露了在陌生海域作战的困难。
entries.summaryEn: In 1274 the Mongol Empire and its Korean vassal launched the first invasion of Japan, the Battle of Bun'ei. The combined force raided Tsushima and Iki, landed at Hakata Bay and established positions on islands in the bay, but could not secure a foothold on the mainland and withdrew after several days.
entries.significanceZh: 文永之役是蒙古帝国首次跨海进攻日本，虽未成功，却促使日本加强九州防御并加深对外来威胁的警觉。
entries.significanceEn: Bun'ei was the first Mongol attempt to invade Japan; its failure led Japan to strengthen the defences of Kyushu against a second attack.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记1274年，维基数据P585为1274年11月、精度到月，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.summaryZh: 1912年12月16日，第一次巴尔干战争期间，希腊皇家海军在达达尼尔海峡口外的伊里海域击败奥斯曼海军，这是巴尔干战争中最主要的海战。希腊舰队迫使奥斯曼舰队退回海峡，随后夺取爱琴海诸岛的制海权。此役确立了希腊在爱琴海的优势，也影响了战后岛屿归属的谈判。
entries.summaryEn: On 16 December 1912, during the First Balkan War, the Royal Hellenic Navy defeated the Ottoman fleet off Elli near the mouth of the Dardanelles in the largest naval battle of the Balkan Wars. The Ottomans withdrew into the straits and Greece gained command of the Aegean, which shaped the post-war settlement of the islands.
entries.significanceZh: 伊里海战使希腊掌握爱琴海制海权，是巴尔干战争中影响战后领土安排的关键海战。
entries.significanceEn: Elli gave Greece command of the Aegean and was the naval battle that shaped the post-war division of the islands.

entries.summaryZh: 1945年5月14日至15日，即德国投降六天后，南斯拉夫军队在斯洛文尼亚波利亚纳附近阻击一支约三万人的轴心国撤退纵队，纵队包括德军、克罗地亚部队、黑山人与斯洛文尼亚国民卫队等。战斗是二战欧洲战场的最后交战之一，受阻的纵队随后向英军投降。
entries.summaryEn: On 14 and 15 May 1945, six days after Germany's surrender, Yugoslav forces stopped a column of some 30,000 retreating Axis soldiers near Poljana in Slovenia. The column mixed Wehrmacht, Croatian, Montenegrin, Serbian and Slovene collaborationist units; the battle was one of the last engagements of the war in Europe.
entries.significanceZh: 波利亚纳战役是二战欧洲战场最后的交战之一，数万轴心国官兵在此受阻并最终向盟军投降。
entries.significanceEn: Poljana was one of the final engagements of the Second World War in Europe, where tens of thousands of Axis troops were halted and forced to surrender.
